description: Deprecated: returns a sign-up link instead of creating an API key, ignores its arguments and stores nothing. Don't call it to get access — every other tool works without a key (get_signals returns a 3-signal preview, get_stats is public). Users create keys at https://signals.x70.ai/mcp-signup and set them as the X-Api-Key header. Kept only so older clients don't break.
name: register
title: Register for Trading Signals API
